corrections.say: One honest note first: no ad platform can hand us a list of everyone interested in your business. What we can do is combine signals: people near you who are searching for what you offer right now, visitors to your website, and careful expansion from there, all inside your area.

questions.prompt: Where should the ads centre? A street address, or the city and ZIP code. If you would rather say later, just say so.
